scenario.title: Translation vendor swap before the Ozawa PCT deadline
scenario.setting: A solo patent attorney at Marlowe & Voss Legal who depends on a legal assistant to track client call notes and filing deadlines

items.text: The practice sits in Suite 4, Meridian House, 18 Canal Street; the front desk collects all courier deliveries and signs for them.
The main clients are Ozawa Medical Devices in Tokyo, Bergström Robotics in Gothenburg and Halley Optics in Bristol.

All patent translations are handled by Vela & Crane Translations in Rotterdam: standard turnaround is 10 business days, orders must be placed at least 12 business days before the filing date, and finished translations are delivered by courier from the Rotterdam office.
The Ozawa Medical Devices PCT application enters the European regional phase with a deadline of 2026-11-20.
Nadia works from home on Tuesdays and takes client calls only in the afternoons on those days.
Filing materials must be complete and checked three business days before any filing deadline.
Client call notes are logged in the case file on the same day the call happens.
Any expense over €500 needs the client's written sign-off before it is committed.
Adopt CaseLoop as the docketing software for all filing deadlines, replacing the spreadsheet.
For the Bergström Robotics European filing due 2026-12-04, the Swedish translation will be ordered from Vela & Crane by 2026-11-16 so it is delivered by 2026-11-27.
Pay the CaseLoop annual invoice of €360. Done on 2026-07-19.
The Ozawa PCT specification runs to 74 pages and is in Japanese; a full English translation is needed for the European filing.
Sequence listings for the Ozawa case are prepared in-house with the PATSEQ tool and need no outside help.
The Ozawa translation will be ordered from Vela & Crane, with the order placed by 2026-11-04 and delivery by 2026-11-10 so the three-day check window before the 2026-11-20 deadline is protected.
Keep Vela & Crane on their €400-per-quarter retainer through the fourth quarter of 2026, since it stays under the sign-off threshold and covers both pending translation jobs.
The Bergström Robotics specification is 41 pages and written in Swedish.
Keep the Ozawa sequence-listing preparation in house with PATSEQ; no vendor is to be engaged for it.

Linden Words, a Rotterdam translation agency, quoted €0.18 per word for Japanese-to-English patent translations with a 14-business-day turnaround, the quote being valid through October 2026; Nadia declined it for the Bergström case on price.
Place the translation order for the Ozawa PCT specification so the translation is delivered in time for the 2026-11-20 filing. Not done yet.
Book a courier pickup of the finished Ozawa translation at Vela & Crane's Rotterdam office on 2026-11-11, the day after its planned delivery.
Use the new one-page call-note template with fields for client, date, matters discussed and next step.
Halley Optics has asked for help renewing a UK trademark, due 2027-02-01; it is unrelated to any translation work.
Place the Bergström Swedish translation order according to the filing plan. Not done yet.

Per-page rates and the €500 client sign-off rule are unchanged.
